# BoomOpen Workflow Kit Pro (v5.5.0)

> Smart-Hybrid Multi-Agent Orchestration, Contract-First 3-Wave Swarm Sharding, Multi-Session Project Autopilot, and Deterministic CLI Compiler Suite across 5 AI coding platforms (Google Antigravity 2.0, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).

## Canonical Inventory
- Version: v5.5.0
- Platforms (5): Antigravity 2.0, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot
- Slash Commands: 32 base commands (84 files: 79 workflows + 5 shared references)
- Specialist Agents: 21 domain engineers & auditors
- Adversarial Teams: 18 Golden Diamond / Triangle teams (72 files)
- Skills Vault: 1,462 indexed skills (22 core + 1,440 library across 19 domains)
- Multilingual Routing: 17 supported languages

## Quick Install (From Git Clone)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Kennyboom/BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro.git
cd BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro
node cli/install.js install --all
node cli/install.js doctor
```

## Deterministic CLI Subcommands (12)
- `install` / `uninstall` / `list` / `doctor` / `settings`: SHA-256 manifest lifecycle & Control Center UI (`--ui`)
- `research` / `design` / `plan` / `cook`: Static `< 50ms` artifact validators (`RES-G1..G4`, `DESIGN-G1..G4`, `PLAN-G1..G5`, `COOK-G1..G4`) & wave packet compilers
- `ledger` / `conduct` / `check`: `.boomopen/project-ledger.json` phase ratchet, Multi-Engine Council (`claude,codex,antigravity`), and Pragmatic 2-Tier static gate (`--strict-phase --no-stubs`)

- [Agents & Golden Diamond Teams](https://boomopen.vercel.app/agents): 21 specialist agents and 18 adversarial review teams
- [Skills Vault Explorer](https://boomopen.vercel.app/skills): 1,462 indexed skills across 19 engineering domains
- [Architecture & CLI Gates](https://boomopen.vercel.app/architecture): Tier 0 vs Tier 1 sharding, SHARED_CONTRACT locks, and Autopilot ratchet

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Kennyboom/BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro): Source code, rules, agents, skills, and release notes
